about.title: Palos Verdes Estates Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Palos Verdes Estates sees fewer collisions than many neighboring communities, but the winding grades along Palos Verdes Drive West, Via Del Monte, and Granvia Altamira still produce real injuries — recent public records show 11 injury collisions and 12 people hurt in a single year. Friday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. tend to bring more reported crashes, likely tied to commuter traffic squeezing through these curving residential roads. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the days right after matter: insurers move quickly, and evidence like skid marks, damaged guardrails, or witness memories fades fast. We're a personal injury law practice that handles car accident claims on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover. Our team understands how these local roads factor into a claim and can start preserving evidence right away.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, but that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government entity — like the City of Palos Verdes Estates or Los Angeles County — is involved. We can help identify who's responsible before that deadline passes.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work in Your Favor
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you're partly blamed for the crash, you can still recover a percentage of damages. Our team can help make sure fault isn't unfairly shifted onto you during negotiations.

items.title: No Cap Doesn't Mean No Fight
items.desc: California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering, but insurers still try to minimize those amounts. Avoiding a recorded statement with the other driver's insurer and letting us handle communications helps protect your claim's value.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers often use these statements to find inconsistencies or minimize your claim. We can communicate with the insurer on your behalf instead.

items.question: What if the crash happened at an intersection along Palos Verdes Drive West?
items.answer: Collisions on curving roads like Palos Verdes Drive West often involve disputes over speed, visibility, or right-of-way. Documenting the scene — photos, witness names, and any dashcam footage — can help us reconstruct what happened. Public crash-count data for that corridor can also provide useful context during a claim.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a car accident in Palos Verdes Estates?
items.answer: In California, you typically have two years from the date of the accident to file a personal injury lawsuit. If a government vehicle or road defect maintained by the city or county was involved, that deadline can be as short as six months. Speaking with us early helps make sure you don't miss a shortened filing window.
